license_scope: The frozen Matbench model registry lists the checkpoint license as BSD-3-Clause; the upstream repository BSD notice is preserved. No assertion is made that the model code license licenses every underlying training-data record. The training corpus is not redistributed.
training_disclosure: Pretrained on Materials Project GGA/GGA+U trajectories (about 1.5 million structures from 146,000 compounds), including energy, force, stress and magnetic-moment targets. Overlap with the benchmark materials is possible; this evaluates downstream thermal predictions, not wholly unseen materials.
